scientific_scope: Prospective computational realization of the already-frozen shared26 pi0.5 training unit after physical-batch-64 single-A100 infeasibility. This child is not claimed to be bitwise or RNG-stream equivalent to the original physical-batch-64 execution.

invariants.dataset_ordering: same source shuffle mechanism and seed; K consecutive physical micro-batches form one effective optimizer batch
invariants.ema_update_cadence: once per effective optimizer update, never once per micro-batch
invariants.terminal_checkpoint: source-emitted effective optimizer step label 49999 only

selection_rule: Test candidates strictly in listed order using no-update dry accumulated-gradient memory qualification. Advance to the next candidate only if the previous candidate fails specifically because of GPU RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED or another resource infeasibility before any optimizer update. Stop at the first candidate that completes the accumulated gradient. Never inspect loss values or scientific outcomes for candidate selection.

accumulation_semantics.gradient: For K consecutive micro-batches, compute each micro-gradient, scale by 1/K, and accumulate into one gradient tree; call optimizer exactly once on the accumulated gradient.
accumulation_semantics.train_state_step: increments once per effective batch of 64 examples
accumulation_semantics.lr_schedule_step: advances once per effective optimizer update
accumulation_semantics.ema: updated once after the single optimizer update for the effective batch
accumulation_semantics.checkpoint_step: counts effective optimizer updates, not micro-batches
accumulation_semantics.data_consumption: 64 source-shuffled examples are consumed per effective update
accumulation_semantics.rng: Each effective step uses deterministic per-microbatch RNG keys derived from the frozen seed and effective step index. Because source physical-batch-64 pi0.5 draws augmentation/noise/time randomness for the full batch in one call, this child intentionally freezes a new deterministic RNG expansion and must not be described as bitwise/source-RNG equivalent.

candidate_may_pass_only_if: accumulated gradient tree is finite by structural/non-numerical checks only
no optimizer update or parameter mutation occurs

claim_boundary: If this child is used for the paper, describe it as the frozen shared26 treatment executed with a preregistered single-GPU microbatch-accumulation implementation. Do not claim exact replication of the original physical-batch-64 RNG stream.
